reels.caption:
Step inside The Palagiri House in Kochi, a 9,000 sq. ft. tropical residence built on a 619 sq.m urban plot in Kaloor. Rising out of a neighborhood defined by narrow lanes and closely packed houses, this four-bedroom home shows how architecture can transform a tight urban site into a spacious, light-filled retreat. Completed in just 18 months, the house blends tropical design principles with modern family living.

Instead of occupying the entire ground, the architects lifted the home above a parking level—freeing up nearly 40% of the land at the front. This rare luxury in a dense city setting allowed the residence to breathe, creating openness and visibility while maintaining privacy. Inside, the home unfolds as a series of layered spaces: a gentle ramp and sit-out lead into a soaring double-height drawing room, gradually transitioning upward into family areas, private bedrooms, and a rooftop pavilion.
